@@ -141,9 +141,30 @@ mod SelfhostLexerV2 do
   def scan_str([c | rest], acc) := scan_str(rest, [c | acc])
   def scan_str([], acc) := [TStr(Prim.str_from_chars(rev(acc, [])))]
 
+  # a char literal: `'a'` (one char + close quote) or `'\n'` (a backslash escape,
+  # one char + close quote). The escape clause MUST precede the plain one.
   def scan_char(cs Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
+  def scan_char(['\\', e, q | rest]) when q == '\'' := [TChar(char_esc(e)) | lex(rest)]
   def scan_char([c, q | rest]) when q == '\'' := [TChar(Prim.char_code(c)) | lex(rest)]
 
+  # decode a single-character escape to its codepoint — the named set of
+  # Rian.Lexer.char_escape (the `\xHH`/`\uHHHH` numeric escapes are out of slice).
+  def char_esc(e Char) Int53
+  def char_esc('a') := 7
+  def char_esc('b') := 8
+  def char_esc('d') := 127
+  def char_esc('e') := 27
+  def char_esc('f') := 12
+  def char_esc('n') := 10
+  def char_esc('r') := 13
+  def char_esc('s') := 32
+  def char_esc('t') := 9
+  def char_esc('v') := 11
+  def char_esc('0') := 0
+  def char_esc('\\') := 92
+  def char_esc('\'') := 39
+  def char_esc('\"') := 34
+
   # ── identifiers / keyword classification (slices 1-2) ─────────────────────
   def lex_id(cs Vec(Char), chars Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
   def lex_id([c | rest], chars) when (c >= 'a' and c <= 'z') or (c >= 'A' and c <= 'Z') or (c >= '0' and c <= '9') or c == '_' := lex_id(rest, [c | chars])

@@ -110,6 +110,15 @@ defmodule Rian.FixpointTest do
     "'A'",
     "foo \"bar\" + 'z'",
     "if c == 'x' do \"yes\" else \"no\" end",
+    # escaped char literals (\n \t \r \\ \') — toward tokenizing the lexer's OWN
+    # source (`lex(['\n' | rest])`, `c == '\t'`, …), which `scan_char` choked on
+    ~S|'\n'|,
+    ~S|'\t'|,
+    ~S|'\r'|,
+    ~S|'\\'|,
+    ~S|'\''|,
+    ~S|c == '\n' or c == '\t'|,
+    ~S/lex(['\n' | rest])/,
     # slice 4 — number lexemes: `_` separators, decimals, exponents (norm_num)
     "1_000",
     "3.14",
